title: Dwight K. Schrute, (Acting) Manager
one_paragraph_synopsis: Dwight unexpectedly takes on the role of acting manager, leading to humorous conflicts and office activities. The segment explores Dwight's brief tenure, office dynamics, and subsequent events including a gun incident and managerial replacement discussions.

main_threads.thread: Dwight's brief tenure as acting manager and office conflicts

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Mose… you'll never guess where I am right now.
Dwight: Okay, you know what? I would love to join The Fist.
Jim: Dwight has been acting manager for three months now. No. A week. Just feels like three months.
Dwight: I will never be happier than I am right now.
